config_study_yml:
# Study settings shared by everyone. Change a value here, not in the SQL.
# Your own Redshift username and driver folder go in config/local.yml (not committed).

run:
  # Which people to run on, when no --profile is given:
  #   sample_1pct   the repeatable ~1% sample of people (File 00); tables end in _s1
  #   sample_30pct  the repeatable ~30% sample; tables end in _s30
  #   full          everyone; tables have no suffix
  # Each profile has its own tables and results/<profile>/ folder, so all three can run at once.
  profile: sample_1pct

redshift:
  host: ohdsi-lab-redshift-cluster-prod.clsyktjhufn7.us-east-1.redshift.amazonaws.com
  port: 5439
  database: ohdsi_lab

komodo_schema: komodo_202606

# Each person-year is one calendar year, Jan 1 to Dec 31, with Dec 31 as the index date.
# 2016 is the first full year of ICD-10 codes; 2025 is the last full year in the extract.
study_years:
  first: 2016
  last: 2025

pharmacy:
  # A fill counts only when it is the final version of the claim and was paid
  # (STANDALONE = never adjusted, FINAL = last version of an adjusted claim).
  final_status: [FINAL, STANDALONE]
  paid_result: PAID

conditions:
  # A person has a study condition in a year with at least this many inpatient claims,
  # OR this many outpatient claims on different days. Code lists: reference/conditions.csv.
  min_inpatient_claims: 1
  min_outpatient_claims: 2

matching:
  # File 11 (MatchIt): within each year, exact on sex, propensity score from birth year,
  # census region and race, nearest neighbour without replacement.
  # ratio = controls per person with HIV: 1:1, as agreed with the PI (Oct 2026). With a ratio
  # above 1, use the match weights (ps_matched.match_weight) for any average; the summaries do.
  ratio: 1
  # Maximum distance between matched people, in standard deviations of the score's logit.
  caliper_sd: 0.2

gagne:
  # Care-quality results are also shown by Gagne level (score without the HIV/AIDS group).
  # Each number is the top of a level: [0, 2, 4] gives "0 or less", "1-2", "3-4", "5+".
  level_tops: [0, 2, 4]

measures:
  # How far back a measure may look for its numerator (the hearing screen looks back
  # 5 years), so procedure and pharmacy claims are read from this many years before 2016.
  lookback_years: 5
